Între doi atomi neutri (de exemplu doi a: Two forces act simultaneously between two neutral atoms (for example two neon atoms):
— norii electronici se polarizează recip: — the electron clouds polarize one another and their instantaneous dipoles attract. The force decreases with distance (energy ∝ −1/r⁶).
— la distanțe mici, norii electronici se: — at short distances the electron clouds overlap and the atoms repel strongly. The force increases very sharply (energy ∝ 1/r¹²).

Forța este panta curbei, cu semn schimba: The force is the negative slope of the curve: F = −dU/dr. Where the curve slopes down to the right the atoms repel; where it slopes up to the right they attract.
La distanța de echilibru r₀ forța rezult: At the equilibrium distance r₀ the net force is zero and the energy is at its minimum. Displace and release the moving atom to make it oscillate around r₀, resembling a molecular vibration.
cu cât ε este mai mare, cu atât atomii s: the larger ε is, the more strongly the atoms are bound. This is why argon (larger ε) boils at a higher temperature (87 K) than neon (27 K).
